name: Product UI micro-interactions (generic)

source.description: Two inspected product promos demonstrate software with typed inputs, cursor clicks, toggles, notification stacks, a long link compressing into a short pill and charts drawing.

technique: Simplified, generic UI fragments perform one interaction each (type, click, toggle, notify, compress) in close-up, so a product's value is shown as action rather than as a screenshot tour.
purpose: Product promos and onboarding: show what the product does in seconds.
visual_behaviour: A URL types itself and shrinks into a short pill; a cursor glides and clicks a button that depresses; toggles flip; cards stack in; a chart line draws with a counter.
mechanics: Typewriter, FLIP width morphs, cursor paths with ease-in-out and a press scale, staggered card entrances, counters.
failure_modes: Recreating a real product's proprietary UI (forbidden without authorisation)
Too much UI detail to read at 720p or on phones

implementation.approach: Studio.comp.ui (runtime 1.18.0): generic, unbranded input (types by a proxy character count, caret), button (press scale and brighten), toggle (proxy knob and track), cursor (moves on a hand-like arc with different x and y eases to a target measured as it renders, click with ripple) and notification (drops in with back.out).

priority.note: Highest-value missing piece for the product-promo template.

provenance.observed: A typed long link becomes a short link pill; a dashboard chart draws and switches metrics (approx., from overview spacing).
A link is pasted into an input and submitted with a cursor click; settings toggles flip on a phone mockup.
An upload card fills a progress bar, a script editor highlights a line, and a cursor clicks the end-card button.
A 'Taken' button fills a grid of days cell by cell; a tap ripple ring expands over a phone close-up.
A reply box types a response and a send button appears.
Table rows fill one by one and a cursor selects a row, each with an accent (8.24-10.70 s).
Notes type with a live preview; a card toggles; the cursor clicks the theme toggle (21.63 s).
A click opens a popup (0.53 s); an agent chat answers and opens an integrations screen (15.25-18.96 s).
A craving types into a prompt field, a chat confirms the dish and a cursor presses Order (9.26-9.75 s).
A handle types into an input, a profile card appears, and a cursor clicks the end-card button (19.6 s).
Contact rows highlight, a prospect card builds with a score, and a message types in a composer.
A search result drops in, a Play button appears, and the app window floods green as the playing state (7.65-7.85 s).
A code card grows in, an API call types with a caret, and a 'Settled' status appears (12.98-15.21 s).
A cursor presses a pill button, drags a 'golden hour' slider that relights the photo, picks frame and size, and orders (Ordered state at 20.46 s).
A terminal types a one-line command and prints output beside the headline (6.4-10.6 s).
A cursor presses play, drags a volume slider, flips a toggle and types a search query; each interaction triggers the next state.
A prompt types into a chat input over about 3.5 s and is sent (5.0-10.1 s).
On a device-sized terminal an order ticket slides in, the buy button is pressed and a confirmation pill appears (38.4-40.7 s).
A link types into an input with a red button (2.6-3.4 s), a transcript panel fills, a waveform panel runs a playhead (8.5-10 s) and a JSON panel lights green (11.0-12.4 s).
In two panes at once a cursor opens windows (1.1-1.9 s), a prompt types on a desktop (4.1-5.2 s) and image cards pop up and multiply (6.24-8.1 s).
A call card rings and turns to missed (0-3.4 s), chat bubbles and a waveform build (6.4-10.9 s), calendar events pop into slots (14.7-16.2 s), a booking page offers a QR code (38.9-40.4 s).
Inbox rows add one at a time beside particle share and save icons (5.7-6.4 s).
On the phone a word is tapped and a definition card opens (24.9 s), saved and marked on the page (27.7 s), then a chat answers a question about the story (38.9 s).
A prompt types and Create is clicked (4.1-5.6 s); the end card's button is clicked by a cursor (13.7-13.9 s).
A price card's button is clicked by a cursor and confirms (33.6-34.4 s).

licensing_notes: Technique only. The references show two companies' proprietary UIs and logos: never reproduce them; use generic, original UI.

evidence.notes: 0 errors, 0 warnings; contact sheet inspected on Windows (Playwright preview, not a HyperFrames render).
